lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Here is a thing nobody has any reason to have told you. Every member of this senate declares their interests in writing once a year, the declarations are public, and anybody at all may read them. Nobody has, since the register went digital, because the digital index only reaches back to 2058 and nothing before that was ever keyed in.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Thirty-three years of declarations that technically exist and functionally do not. The paper register goes back to 2031 and it lives in the chamber cloakroom, which is not somewhere a staffer may go. Cross-check it against tonight's signatories and I will finally know who I have been working for since I was twenty-four.

choices.text: We can get into the cloakroom.
